fullPassage: Whales are highly efficient at carbon storage. When they die, each whale sequesters an average of 30 tons of carbon dioxide, taking that carbon out of the atmosphere for centuries. For comparison, the average tree absorbs only 48 pounds of CO2 a year. From a climate perspective, each whale is the marine equivalent of thousands of trees. Whales also help sequester carbon by fertilizing the ocean as they release nutrient-rich waste, in turn increasing phytoplankton populations, which also sequester carbon — leading some scientists to call them the "engineers of marine ecosystems." In 2019, economists from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) estimated the value of the ecosystem services provided by each whale at over $2 million USD. They called for a new global program of economic incentives to return whale populations to preindustrial whaling levels as one example of a "nature-based solution" to climate change. Calls are now being made for a global whale restoration program, to slow down climate change.

questions.passage: Whales are highly efficient at carbon storage. When they die, each whale sequesters an average of 30 tons of carbon dioxide, taking that carbon out of the atmosphere for centuries. For comparison, the average tree absorbs only 48 pounds of CO2 a year. From a climate perspective, each whale is the marine equivalent of thousands of trees. Whales also help sequester carbon by fertilizing the ocean as they release nutrient-rich waste, in turn increasing phytoplankton populations, which also sequester carbon — leading some scientists to call <u>them</u> the "engineers of marine ecosystems." In 2019, economists from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) estimated the value of the ecosystem services provided by each whale at over $2 million USD. They called for a new global program of economic incentives to return whale populations to preindustrial whaling levels as one example of a "nature-based solution" to climate change. Calls are now being made for a global whale restoration program, to slow down climate change.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'them'은 탄소를 격리하고 생태계를 돕는 주체인 고래(Whales)를 가리킨다.
det.analysis:
① 식물성 플랑크톤 — 고래가 늘리는 대상일 뿐 지칭 아님 ❌
② 고래들 — 'call them the engineers of marine ecosystems'에서 생태계를 돕는 주체는 고래 ← 정답
③ 경제학자들 — 뒤 문장에 등장하지만 지칭 대상 아님 ❌
④ 과학자들 — them을 부르는 주체이지 지칭 대상 아님 ❌
det.tip: 생태계의 엔지니어라 불리는 주체는 글의 주인공 고래이다.
